dedupe_keys.name: kenya number of acreage under irrigation in bomet county

description: Kenya - Number of Acreage under Irrigation in Bomet county is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Kenya Red Cross Society. This dataset shows the land owned under irrigation. A majority, (96.3%) of the 789 households that reported owning land of the residents in Bomet do not have land under irrigation with only a few (2.8%) having between 0-2 acres of land under irrigation. Coverage: Kenya. The portal files it under the publisher Kenya Red Cross Society. Its tags are food security. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2022-01-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain / No restrictions (CC0) (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
